plant.description: The path to place the branches on.

offset_single.description: Moves every second branch up toward the next one, 1 makes pairs

lowest_branch.description: How low should the branches start. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

highest_branch.description: How high should the branches start. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

depth.description: On how many layern of branches should we place branches.

amount.description: The amount of branches to generate.

resolution_curve.description: The resolution of a branch as long as the longest path, shorter branches get fewer points.

rotation.description: How far every branch turns around the path from the one before it, in radians: 2.3998 is the golden angle (137.5°), 3.1416 puts them in two ranks. The first branch points to the side, 1.5708 down and 4.7124 up from there. Read for every branch.

angle.description: Tilts every branch from sticking straight out of the path, in radians: positive toward the tip of the path (up on an upright stem), negative toward its base, 1.5708 along it. Read for every branch. To let a tip nod past horizontal, use gravity with a strength above 1.

taper.description: How much the thickness tapers to the tip. 1 = a cone, 0 = the thickness input alone sets the profile.

growth.description: How much of the branch has grown. Below 1 it is that share of its length, and what sits on it stays where it will be on the full-grown branch: kinks, points, branches and instances above the tip are left out until it reaches them. Above 1 the branch is full-grown and only gets older, path_info reads it as grown and age.
